While the premise of "babies switched at birth in a hospital" is a classic trope, the story subverts it in an entirely original way. Instead of treating the mix-up as a tragic accident or a dramatic mystery to be solved, the protagonist—ironically an art provenance researcher whose job is to verify authenticity—realizes the mistake immediately and consciously chooses to keep the wrong baby to spare her child from her and her husband's anxious genetic lineage. Furthermore, the prose relies on fresh, specific imagery and avoids overused expressions.
